comments.author: Visitor
comments.body:
Surprisingly, this quest turned up for my alt today. They had battle level 22, 8458 battle fame, and were in Helmsperson job at the time. Curiously, I could not share it with a friend who had port permits up through EA, and 12.5 battle fame; they received the following message: "Quest taken by the admiral satisfied certain conditions, so certain requirements has been reduced, it cannot be shared to others in the fleet."

Neither of our characters had ever been in Bodyguard job before. We did not meet even one of the quest skill requirements. And while this was the first time the quest appeared for my alt, I know for a fact this quest can be shared with others. As a matter of fact, I held the quest until another could join us; they received the same message, up until they changed into Bodyguard, and then the quest became visible for them to accept. And lastly, when I brought my Historian main into Seville, the quest was actually waiting at the mediator, without first having to fleet with my alt, or change jobs.

I'm not sure if any of this information will be of use. It is of slight interest, though. I would love to know why this quest appeared for me twice when I wasn't in the correct Bodyguard job, but no one else could accept it without first changing to Bodyguard, which is supposed to be the condition that makes it visible in the first place...
